now.title: Jessica Jones S2
now.text: After Simpson is killed, Trish uses the IGH enhancer she took from him and grows addicted to it.

proposed.text: In episode 9, after Simpson is killed, Trish grows addicted to the IGH enhancer she took from him and uses it up.

changes.evidence: Jessica Jones S2 episode 9: Trish, on the IGH drug, quits her show and then realizes she has run out of the drug (Wikipedia); the Combat Enhancer Inhaler page says she found it empty and could not reproduce it, leaving it defunct (JJ209). The season leaves the drug used up, not in use; the files use 'Destroyed' for a used-up supply (e.g. the lizard cure).
